blocking.title: On a phone the map modes cannot be chosen: the new map-mode menu (c689c2e4) is clipped by the bottom bar's overflow:auto; at 390x844 0 of 11 options are hit-testable, a tap on Terrain times out, the mode stays Political (desktop and tablet widths 768-1600 px are fine; the old button cycled on a tap).
blocking.fix: Render the menu outside the scrolling bar (portal or position:fixed at the button's rect), or cycle the mode on touch; bar: at 390x844 every option hit-testable and a tap changes the mode.
